comments: Narrative on the Buddha's life, turning of the wheels and associated works. Although not a "chos 'byung" in the sense of a chronicle on the spread of Buddhism to Tibet, this may be be the work with which Bu ston (ID:5999) related to be familiar (see [2X2E3882]: 248).
alternative_names: de ltar bshad cing nyan pa'i 'bras bu bstan pa dang mdzad byang
name: chos 'byung kun dga' snying po
